## Historical audit: H0095

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane2/codex_parallel_08_lane2_shared/hint_gen/ink-grid-box-layout/trajs.json`. Event references below are to this file; offsets are half-open character ranges in the supplied observations.

**Inferred goal:** prepare guidance for adding grid box layout to Ink. The actual issue text is not visible, so the precise requirements cannot be independently established. This is a **teacher-only guidance trace**, not a student implementation trace.

| Evidence | Observed operations and limits |
|---|---|
| Reference inspection | The teacher read `/tmp/golden_diff.diff`: it describes a new grid-layout pass and changes to styles and rendering, but is a reference diff, not evidence those changes were applied to the repository (main_agent:event:2, [0,35849)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The teacher searched layout integration and tests, then read the renderer, render-to-string, styles, Box, DOM and package configuration. The search showed layout calls and existing gap/display tests; it did not run them (events 3–18; notably event 4 [0,2884), event 6 [0,4712), event 18 [0,2848)). |
| Detection and diagnosis | The starting style API exposes flex/none and maps non-flex display values to hidden; the renderer allocates output from computed Yoga dimensions and has a separate screen-reader branch (events 10 [0,44560), 6 [0,4712)). The teacher identified risks in placement, sizing, canvas height and persistent Yoga mutations; these are diagnoses or hypotheses, not observed test failures (event 21 [0,7334)). |
| Proposed versus executed | The guide proposed a separate grid pass, tests and checks for rerenders, gaps, intrinsic sizing and accessibility. The only observed write created `/tmp/hint_output.md`; no repository implementation or test execution is shown (events 19 [0,7334), 20 [0,7237), 21 [0,7334)). The reference diff is nonempty but contains no test-file changes (event 2 [0,35849)). |
| Outcome and adoption | Metadata records successful completion of the **guidance session**, and the final response supplies the guide (top_level_metadata [0,11256); event 21 [0,7334)). This is not formal success of a grid implementation. No student receipt, adoption, patch, test result or downstream outcome is visible; availability of the guide alone does not establish receipt. |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** The transferable observation is to trace data flow and lifecycle boundaries before treating a reference patch as validated. Task-specific unresolved hypotheses include whether fixed-max track allocation overuses remaining space, whether empty templates or partially specified placement behave safely, and whether grid mutations or canvas resizing leave stale or inconsistent geometry. The teacher recommended tests for these cases; none are shown. There is no evidence here to classify an implementation as partially correct, an algorithm failure, an empty implementation patch, or a technical interruption. The implementation outcome remains **unknown**.
